supplied_epoch_rule.precedence: UNKNOWN precedence (contract invariant, orchestrator 2026-10-18T15:59Z, narrowed 16:03Z): before c9192134 is applied, a supplied hb_epoch that is the epoch source (an SV_CHANGE record's hb_epoch; an absent field reads as null) and is JSON null, "", "null" or the literal UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED is FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED (UNKNOWN is FAIL_CLOSED, never DENY). invariants.statement: the canonical marker for an ALLOW whose optional hb_epoch cross-check was left out is P1's: top-level cross_checked false plus detail HB_EPOCH_NOT_CROSS_CHECKED (sv_work_items.verify_admission_hb_epoch(HB_EPOCH_NOT_CROSS_CHECKED, ...)); it is not moved into hb_epoch_cross_check. AMENDMENT (orchestrator ~17:15Z, accepted): the producer ALWAYS emits cross_checked. A cross-checked ALLOW carries cross_checked true and the supplied value; an omitted-flag ALLOW carries cross_checked false and detail HB_EPOCH_NOT_CROSS_CHECKED; a DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH carries cross_checked true. RULING (decided by invariant, ~17:05Z, extended ~17:15Z): a readback that is missing cross_checked, or that carries hb_epoch_cross_check (the Labs#3266 2ba0e329 shape), is VOID: a self-seal (result_sha256) cannot prove which producer path ran, so a stripped-and-resealed readback verifies as a seal yet is not authentically observed. verify_admission_hb_epoch gives FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED (failed_predicate READBACK_SHAPE_MATCHES_PINNED_PRODUCER, all six fields), never DENY, for every void shape. P1's own outputs and fixtures follow this

an ALLOW with cross_checked true that lacks supplied_hb_epoch equal (ASCII digits or a JSON integer, by value) to the sealed hb_epoch, or carries the not-cross-checked detail
a DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH without cross_checked true and supplied_hb_epoch, or with the not-cross-checked detail
any other non-ALLOW readback with cross_checked true (7ad6d81f FAIL_CLOSED: cross_checked false)
